response: {"turns":[{"id":"M2:T21","text":"Okay."},{"id":"M2:T22","text":"so food samples, environmental samples,"},{"id":"M2:T23","text":"and really any other kind of sample that's going to get tested for biological,"},{"id":"M2:T24","text":"Right."},{"id":"M2:T25","text":"chemical, or radiological agents."},{"id":"M2:T26","text":"Got it."},{"id":"M2:T27","text":"And every specimen or sample we collect for lab testing has to get an identifier, so a"},{"id":"M2:T28","text":"Mm-hm."},{"id":"M2:T29","text":"Specimen ID, and it has to be unique within the jurisdiction."},{"id":"M2:T30","text":"Okay."},{"id":"M2:T31","text":"And the system has to, well, any system supporting OM has to be able to store the data on the specimens and samples collected for lab testing."},{"id":"M2:T32","text":"Sure."},{"id":"M2:T33","text":"Yeah, that makes sense."},{"id":"M2:T34","text":"For environmental samples specifically, the data should cover how it was collected, the collection method,"},{"id":"M2:T35","text":"Okay."},{"id":"M2:T36","text":"the location, geocoded if we can, where"},{"id":"M2:T37","text":"Right."},{"id":"M2:T38","text":"the sample was actually taken, then the source, so for example"},{"id":"M2:T39","text":"Mm-hm."},{"id":"M2:T40","text":"rain or a well if it's water, a radiation release, asbestos, a chair or a desk in some specified location. Then the nature of the sample, like soil, water, air. Quality control data. For air samples, the collection begin and end date and time. And for water samples, the original volume plus the volume of concentrate that got tested."}]}
